turns.teacherReply: Hi Meher, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll learn fractions as equal shares, like dance steps. Ready to begin?

ask.text: Ready to begin?

turns.teacherReply: Meher, imagine sharing one birthday cake equally after a dance show. Would you choose two equal pieces or one big piece?

move.shape: open with one concrete everyday situation built on their interest (dance) — kit contexts: rotis and parathas, birthday cake, watermelon; ask what they think will happen or which they would pick — a prediction, no right answer yet; any bigger/more comparison: two quantities of one kind, in one unit — a count against a count, a distance against a distance; never across kinds; mention once: at the end they will teach this to Golu (a pretend baby elephant just starting school)

ask.text: Would you choose two equal pieces or one big piece?
